title: Vincent van Gogh, Sunflowers, 500 CFA francs, Flowers in Painting Collection
descriptionPlain: Description Discover the timeless beauty of flowers that have inspired the greatest masters of painting for centuries. From delicate accents in still lifes to the expressive compositions of the Impressionists — flowers have always held a special place in art. Artists such as Vincent van Gogh, Henri Matisse, Paul Cézanne and Édouard Manet used the richness of colors and forms to portray flowers as a metaphor of transience, joy and harmony with nature.
